To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the energy harvesting technologies for WSNs are still in their infancy, but the MAC protocol design is a crucial step for a successful implementation of an EH WSN.

(i) the most promising EH technologies are based on solar, vibration, and thermal energy harvesting; (ii) the main challenges for MAC protocols in WBSNs are related to: energy harvesting variability, energy storage, duty cycle management, energy-aware routing, and energy-aware scheduling; (iii) the most promising approaches are based on duty cycle management and on energy storage management; (iv) the main performance indicators are related to: network lifetime, throughput, delay, fairness, and energy efficiency
the MAC protocol design for EH-WSN is challenging due to the unpredictable energy availability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and analysis of energy-efficient MAC protocols for EH-WSNs.
the development of a comprehensive survey on MAC protocols in energy harvesting wireless sensor networks.
the development of a new class of MAC protocols that are able to efficiently exploit energy harvesting capabilities in WSNs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the design of a suitable MAC protocol for an EH WSN is an extremely complex task.
the design of the energy harvesting MAC protocol should take into account both energy availability and time-varying nature of the harvested energy.
the MAC layer is a crucial component of the WSN architecture, and it should not be overlooked when designing a new EH system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this paper provides a complete review of the state-of-the-art in the area of energy harvesting MAC protocols.
this manuscript aims to be the reference work to design MAC protocols for EH-WSNs.
this paper is a comprehensive survey of MAC protocols in energy harvesting wireless sensor networks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of the most appropriate MAC protocol for EH WSN is a complex and challenging task that involves many tradeoffs.
the design of MAC protocols in EH-WSNs should be driven by the specific energy harvesting technology used in a given scenario.
the design of MAC protocols for EH-WSNs requires a careful analysis of the energy harvesting system and a deep understanding of the interplay between the EH system and MAC layer.
